contentList.content: Personal toggle, enabled by default and saved with the game. Outside combat: enhanced leap, feather fall, speak with animals, 12 m darkvision, slipping immunity and difficult-terrain immunity. Suspended in combat and restored afterwards. Turning off removes only this mod's benefits.

Outside combat: triple jump distance, no fall damage, speak with animals, at least 12 m darkvision, slipping immunity and difficult-terrain immunity. Suspended on entering combat. Does not grant general prone immunity or surface damage immunity.
